Info

Executes ASCII stream transmission loop and response processing.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.worker.ascii.stream_loop_runner.StreamLoopRunner(*, flow_pacing: IFlowPacingController, step_dispatcher: IStreamStepDispatcher, queue_drainer: IStreamQueueDrainer, state_controller: IStreamStateController, observer_dispatcher: IStreamObserverDispatcher, pacing_config: StreamPacingConfig)[source]¶

Bases: object

Executes ASCII stream transmission loop and response processing.

It defines:

attributes:
_flow_pacing - IFlowPacingController managing buffer queue.
_step_dispatcher - IStreamStepDispatcher for packet send.
_queue_drainer - IStreamQueueDrainer for post-loop drain.
_state_controller - IStreamStateController managing state.
_observer_dispatcher - IStreamObserverDispatcher for events.
_pacing_config - StreamPacingConfig with loop pacing delays.
methods:
__init__ - Initializes loop runner with injected delegates.
run_loop - Background loop transmitting waypoints.
handle_incoming_line - Evaluates incoming response line.

handle_incoming_line(line: str, *, session: StreamSession) → bool[source]¶

Processes inbound response line and updates session queue depth.

Parameters:

  • line – Raw response line string from microcontroller.

  • session – Active StreamSession model.

Returns:

True if fatal error occurred, False otherwise.

Exceptions:

None.

run_loop(*, session: StreamSession, stop_event: Event, pause_event: Event) → None[source]¶

Transmits waypoints according to flow control buffer capacity.

Parameters:

  • session – Active StreamSession model.

  • stop_event – Event signaling termination.

  • pause_event – Event signaling pause.

Exceptions:

None.
